title: Edit-Induced Dependency Mismatch: Propagation Omissions, Recovery, and Evaluation Blind Spots in Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.29242v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: During iterative code modification, coding agents may continue to rely in subsequent reasoning on outdated dependency judgments whose text remains fixed in the context, leading to errors in subsequent reasoning and leaving consumer defects undetected by the original task evaluations, thereby exposing blind spots in the tested benchmarks. We study actual agent execution trajectories collected on benchmark tasks: deepseek-v4-flash runs on DeepSWE and SWE-bench Verified, supplemented by Qwen3.8-Flash cases on FeatureBench. Focusing on edit-induced consumer obligations, a full-corpus blinded human audit of the DeepSWE runs identifies terminal mismatches, including diagnoses whose task scope remains disputed. Following supplementary execution checks, all retained DeepSWE terminal events have execution support. The audit also shows that recovery within a trajectory can coexist with terminal omissions in the same run. The process analysis links

translated_title: 编辑引发的依赖失配：编码智能体中的传播遗漏、恢复与评估盲区
translated_abstract: 在迭代代码修改过程中，编码智能体可能在后续推理中继续依赖过时的依赖判断，而这些判断的文本仍固定保留在上下文中，从而导致后续推理出错，并使消费者缺陷未被原始任务评估发现，进而暴露了所测基准中的盲区。我们研究了在基准任务上收集的真实智能体执行轨迹：包括 deepseek-v4-flash 在 DeepSWE 和 SWE-bench Verified 上的运行，并以 Qwen3.8-Flash 在 FeatureBench 上的案例作为补充。聚焦于编辑引发的消费者义务，对 DeepSWE 运行结果的全语料盲测人工审计识别出了终端失配，其中包括任务范围仍存争议的诊断。在补充执行检查之后，所有保留的 DeepSWE 终端事件均获得了执行层面的支持。审计还表明，在同一运行中，轨迹内的恢复可以与终端遗漏并存。过程分析将……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了编码智能体在迭代改代码时会依赖上下文中残留的过时依赖判断，导致缺陷传播并逃过基准测试评估，并通过盲测人工审计确认了此类“编辑引发的依赖失配”的真实存在、运行中的恢复现象以及现有评估体系的盲区。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that coding agents may rely on outdated dependency judgments left fixed in context during iterative code editing, propagating consumer defects that evade benchmark evaluations, and uses a blinded human audit of agent trajectories to confirm the existence of such edit-induced dependency mismatches, their within-run recovery, and blind spots in existing benchmarks.
